These '''Gotal''' were trackers who were employed by [[Tendir Blue]], an employee of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], to capture a defector from the Techno Union, [[Ratri Tane]], who had sensitive information about his former employers. The [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] tracked Tane to the [[Homestar]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and after a brief [[Mission to Corellia (Clone Wars)|skirmish]] with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Ylenic It'kla]], the Gotals escaped the cantina with Tane captive. The two Jedi tracked the Gotals to Tendir Blue's headquarters, where the Gotals met another Jedi named [[Nejaa Halcyon]]. This Jedi killed the Gotals by overwhelming their senses with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
